tracked_upgrades.name: github.com/fergusstrange/embedded-postgres
tracked_upgrades.rationale: AUD-15 dated deferral. The 2026-09-06 review downloaded the authoritative latest Go module v1.34.0 (sum h1:c6RKhPKFsLVU+Tdxsx8q0UxCHsvZZ/iShAnljRBXs6s=) and reconfirmed that its go.mod and prepare_database.go still import github.com/lib/pq, so it cannot replace the security-maintained source fork without restoring the dependency the fork removes. The fork is compiled from third_party/embedded-postgres and affects local integration tests and single-node eval startup only. The upgrade must rebase the reviewed fork, preserve the pgx and mandatory-checksum-through-internal/crypto repairs, refresh committed archive pins, and refresh Trivy receipts together, so it is one reviewed change and not a source-version-only bump. The deferral is bounded to 29 days and must be reviewed again by 2026-10-05.
